evals.name: setup-phpunit-from-scratch
evals.prompt: Set up PHPUnit integration tests for my plugin from scratch.
evals.expected_output: composer require --dev phpunit/phpunit brain/monkey mockery/mockery yoast/phpunit-polyfills. Create phpunit.xml.dist with unit+integration suites. Write tests/bootstrap.php loading WP test suite via WP_TESTS_DIR. Create bin/install-wp-tests.sh. Add base Integration_Test_Case extending WP_UnitTestCase with Mockery trait and REST server setup. Add GitHub Actions workflow with MySQL service.

evals.name: unit-test-with-brain-monkey
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for this class that calls get_option and apply_filters without loading WordPress.
evals.expected_output: Extend Unit_Test_Case (Brain\Monkey base). stubEscapeFunctions() and stubTranslationFunctions() called in setUp. Use Functions\when() for get_option stubs. Use Functions\expect() with ->once()->with()->andReturn() for asserted calls. Monkey\setUp() in setUp, Monkey\tearDown() in tearDown. No WP bootstrap required.

evals.name: test-redirect-exit-code
evals.prompt: Write tests for a function that calls wp_safe_redirect() then exit — the test suite keeps dying.
evals.expected_output: Create Redirect exception class in own file. Add wp_redirect filter in setUp that throws Redirect($location) and returns false. Remove filter in tearDown. Wrap call in run() helper that catches Redirect and returns location. Assert on $this->run() return value AND side effects that ran before exit. Tests no longer terminate PHP process.
